  - heading "PARAMETERS ↑ BACK TO TOP" @e22 [level=2]

  · "Parameters can be used to filter and control the results returned by the API. They are passed as nor"
  - ListMarker "1." @e24
  · "require=<field_name>"
  · ": all the rows that have an empty value in the"
  · "specified are removed from the result set - e.g."
  · "require=given_name"
  · "removes all the rows that do not have any string specified in the"
  - ListMarker "2." @e25
  · "filter=<field_name>:<operator><value>"
  · ": only the rows compliant with"
  · "are kept in the result set. The parameter"
  · "is not mandatory. If"
  · "is not specified,"
  · "is interpreted as a regular expression, otherwise it is compared by means of the specified operation"
  · "filter=title:semantics?"
  · "returns all the rows that contain the string \"semantic\" or \"semantics\" in the field"
  · ", while"
  · "filter=date:>2016-05"
  · "returns all the rows that have a"
  · "greater than May 2016."
  - ListMarker "3." @e26
  · "sort=<order>(<field_name>)"
  · ": sort in ascending ("
  · "set to \"asc\") or descending ("
  · "set to \"desc\") order the rows in the result set according to the values in"
  · ". For instance,"
  · "sort=desc(date)"
  · "sorts all the rows according to the value specified in the field"
  · "in descending order."
  - ListMarker "4." @e27
  · "format=<format_type>"
  · ": the final table is returned in the format specified in"
  · "that can be either \"csv\" or \"json\" - e.g."
  · "format=csv"
  · "returns the final table in CSV format. This parameter has higher priority of the type specified thro"
  · "Accept: text/csv"
  · "and the URL of such request includes"
  · "format=json"
  · ", the final table is returned in JSON."
  - ListMarker "5." @e28
  · "json=<operation_type>(\"<separator>\",<field>,<new_field_1>,<new_field_2>,...)"
  · ": in case a JSON format is requested in return, tranform each row of the final JSON table according"
  · "is set to \"array\", the string value associated to the field name"
  · "is converted into an array by splitting the various textual parts by means of"
  · ". For instance, considering the JSON table"
  · "[ { \"names\": \"Doe, John; Doe, Jane\" }, ... ]"
  · ", the execution of"
  · "array(\"; \",names)"
  · ". Instead, if"
  · "is set to \"dict\", the string value associated to the field name"
  · "is converted into a dictionary by splitting the various textual parts by means of"
  · "and by associating the new fields"
  · ", etc., to these new parts. For instance, considering the JSON table"
  · "[ { \"name\": \"Doe, John\" }, ... ]"
  · "dict(\", \",name,fname,gname)"
  · "[ { \"name\": { \"fname\": \"Doe\", \"gname\": \"John\" }, ... ]"
  · "It is possible to specify one or more filtering operation of the same kind (e.g."
  · "require=given_name&require=family_name"
  · "). In addition, these filtering operations are applied in the order presented above - first all the"
  · "operation, then all the"
  · "operations followed by all the"
  · "sort"
  · "operation, and finally the"
  · "operation (if applicable). It is worth mentioning that each of the aforementioned rules is applied i"
  · "Example:"
  · "<api_operation_url>?require=doi&filter=date:>2015&sort=desc(date)"

- heading "/metadata/{ids} ↑ BACK TO OPERATIONS" @e34 [level=3]
  - link "↑ BACK TO OPERATIONS" @e35 dup=1/3
· "This operation retrieves the bibliographic metadata for each of the bibliographic entities identifie"
· "Each ID is built as follows: ID abbreviation + \":\" = ID value. For example, For example \"doi:10.3233"
· "The ID abbreviations currently supported in this operation are \"doi\", \"issn\", \"isbn\", and \"omid\""
· "It is possible to specify one or more IDs as input of this operation. In this case, the IDs should b"
· ": the IDs of the bibliographic entity"
· "title"
· ": the title of the bibliographic entity"
· ": the semicolon-separated list of authors of the bibliographic entity"
· "pub_date"
· ": the date of publication of the bibliographic entity"
· "venue"
· ": the title of the venue where the bibliographic entity has been published, followed by the list of"
· "volume"
· ": the number of the volume in which the bibliographic entity has been published"
· "issue"
· ": the number of the issue in which the bibliographic entity has been published"
· "page"
· ": the starting and ending pages of the bibliographic entity in the context of the venue where it has"
· "type"
· ": the type of the bibliographic entity"
· "ACCEPTED HTTP METHOD(S)"
· "GET"
· "Parameter(s)"
· "str"
· ", regular expression shape"
· "(doi|issn|isbn|omid|openalex|pmid|pmcid):.+?(__(doi|issn|isbn|omid|openalex|pmid|pmcid):.+?)*$"
· "RESULT FIELDS TYPE"
· "(datetime)"
· ", publisher"
· ", editor"
